verdict.rationale: Postman ships an official, first-party Postman CLI. It is documented to run collections with reporters, lint and govern API specs, start mock servers, manage webhooks, generate SDKs, and integrate with CI/CD. It also explicitly gives coding agents Postman CLI context, which fits the AI-native framing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in agent-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Give coding agents Postman CLI context for API discovery, code generation, and maintenance tasks.
The Postman CLI enables you to run collections, lint API schemas, run security and governance checks, and log in and out.
Run and manage collections with extensive configuration options and built-in reporters.
You can also use the Postman CLI to run test collections as part of your continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
